title: halophila ovalis var. minor

It is a submerged aquatic plant found in tropical and subtropical regions, known for its ability to thrive in high-salinity environments. The health benefits of Halophila ovalis var. minor include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body.
